title: The Scariest Start Screen in Minecraft PE (FNAF 2)
topic: Minecraft PE ke main menu ko Five Nights at Freddy’s 2 (FNAF 2) theme dene wala UI/texture pack is video mein showcase kiya gaya hai.
description: Minecraft PE ke main menu ko Five Nights at Freddy’s 2 (FNAF 2) theme dene wala UI/texture pack is video mein showcase kiya gaya hai. Aise UI packs gameplay mechanics ke bajaye game ke visual interface ko customise karte hain — jaise main menu, buttons aur loading/menu screens ka appearance. Video mein pack ka short preview hai; ise use karne se pehle aapke Minecraft build ke saath compatibility check karna zaroori hai.
